<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users struggle to pull in and maintain accurate supplier data without disrupting existing reports, and the system lacks automation for reconciliations and payments. This forces manual work and hinders scalability as supplier requirements grow more complex.",
 "similar": [

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Users can navigate through claim reports using intuitive shortcuts, streamlining access to key data without leaving the current view. Keelwater’s interface ensures quick filtering and drill-downs for efficient claim analysis.\", \"id\": 4137, \"name\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.051,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.049,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },

 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked whether the core problem—pulling in and maintaining accurate supplier data without manual work, plus automation for reconciliations and payments—is solved or covered. Completed story 4129 'Supplier contact details' (completed 2026-09-15) explicitly delivers automatic pulling and updating of supplier data from integrated systems 'without manual entry,' directly solving the first and central clause of the problem. Story 4136 (in progress) further covers supplier data validation, though the reconciliation/payment automation portion remains unaddressed. Because a completed story already solves the same core problem of maintaining accurate supplier data automatically, the duplicate check fails.", "verdict": "fail"}
